title: Kestrel Commercial Fleet Lease Condition Reserve on Credit Refunds for Closed-End Units
content:
# Lease-End Accounting Clause — Condition Reserve on Credit Refunds, Kestrel Commercial Fleet Lease Closed-End Units

**Clause.** For the refund of a credit balance on a turned-in unit of the Kestrel Commercial Fleet Lease, the refund condition reserve for a closed-end unit turned in 30 or fewer days before today is figured as 10 percent of its wear cap, the wear cap being the tier's closed-end wear-charge cap percentage of its capitalized cost; for a closed-end unit turned in 31 to 60 days before today it is a flat $300; for a TRAC unit, or a unit turned in more than 60 days before today, there is none.

**Figuring the wear cap.** The wear cap is the unit's capitalized cost multiplied by the closed-end wear-charge cap percentage of the unit's program tier and divided by 100; the reserve in the first case is that wear cap multiplied by 10 and divided by 100. Neither figure is rounded on its own.

| Program tier | Closed-end wear-charge cap percentage |
|---|---|
| Kestrel Business Advantage | 10 |
| Kestrel Fleet Select | 10 |
| Kestrel Fleet Preferred | 8 |
| Kestrel Fleet Premier | 8 |
| Kestrel Fleet Enterprise | 6 |
| Kestrel National Fleet | 6 |

**Records read.** The unit's lease type (closed-end commercial or TRAC), capitalized cost, program tier and turn-in date. Days run from the turn-in date to today and count the later date but not the earlier one.

## Branch table

| Lease type | Days from turn-in date to today | Condition reserve |
|---|---|---|
| Closed-end commercial | 30 or fewer | 10 percent of the wear cap |
| Closed-end commercial | 31 to 60 | $300 |
| Closed-end commercial | more than 60 | none |
| TRAC | any | none |

## Cases (hypothetical)

1. A closed-end unit with a capitalized cost of 48000 in a tier whose wear-charge cap percentage is 8, turned in 30 days ago: wear cap 3840, reserve 384.
2. The same unit turned in 31 days ago: $300. Turned in 61 days ago: none.
3. A TRAC unit turned in 10 days ago: none.
